launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.3.5 Showcase: the cosmetics picker now shows REAL rendered previews - vanilla pet models on a slow turntable (bunny/chick/piggy/kitty/puppy/slime/mini-me/star), animated aura glows + the ore ring, and capes as gently swaying cloth. Every scroll list (cosmetics, multiplayer, mod menu, settings, worlds) now supports drag-to-scroll with momentum - fixes scrolling on touch/Pojav devices. Discord Rich Presence is zero-setup (the Kinetrix app id ships in the client; the secret is never embedded).
